# br41n-ecog-hand-pose


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

> Analyze an ECoG BCI dataset from an epilepsy patient performing
> rock-paper-scissors hand gestures, and optimize pre-processing,
> feature extraction, and classification against state-of-the-art
> baselines.

## Dataset

`data/ECoG_Handpose.mat` (provided by the BR41N.IO hackathon
organizers):

- **Paradigm:** 90 trials of rock / paper / scissors gestures, cued for
  2s and followed by a 2–3s rest screen.
- **Sampling rate:** 1200 Hz.
- **Recording site:** Right sensorimotor cortex, 60-channel ECoG grid
  spanning pre-/post-central, supra-marginal, inferior parietal, and
  middle/superior frontal gyri.
- **Channel layout** (`[channel × time]`):
  - CH1 — sample time
  - CH2–61 — ECoG (raw, DC-coupled), 60 channels
  - CH62 — paradigm label (`0`=relax, `1`=fist, `2`=peace, `3`=open
    hand)
  - CH63–67 — data glove (thumb, index, middle, ring, little finger
    flexion)

## Notebook pipeline

Each notebook in `nbs/` focuses on one step of the analysis. Functions
defined in earlier notebooks are exported via
[nbdev](https://nbdev.fast.ai/) into the `br41n_ecog_hand_pose` package
and reused in later notebooks.

| Notebook              | Module           | Purpose                                                  |
|-----------------------|------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `01_data_loading`     | `data`           | Load `.mat`, expose ECoG / labels / glove accessors      |
| `02_eda`              | —                | Visualize raw signals, label timeline, channel stats     |
| `03_preprocessing`    | `preprocessing`  | Notch, bandpass, common average reference                |
| `04_epoching`         | `epoching`       | Cue-locked trial segmentation from CH62                  |
| `05_features`         | `features`       | Band power, time-frequency, CSP                          |
| `06_classification`   | `classification` | LDA / SVM / Riemannian baselines                         |
| `07_deep_learning`    | `deep`           | EEGNet / ShallowConvNet end-to-end models                |
| `08_finger_regression`| `regression`     | Continuous decoding of glove channels                    |
| `09_benchmark`        | —                | Compare results against published SOTA                   |

## Developer guide

``` sh
# install in editable mode
$ pip install -e .

# edit notebooks under nbs/, then sync code + docs + tests
$ nbdev_prepare
```
